rivals.blurb: Slow, patient and very hard to rattle. Takes the jobs nobody else will wait for.
A crew of three who post as one. Loud on the boards, quieter at work.
Never uses fewer than nine relays. Nobody has ever traced them, and nobody has ever seen them finish quickly.
Says it is her real name. Nobody believes her, which is the point.
Young, fast and careless. Climbing quickly, falling sometimes.
Dives deep and comes back with records. A favourite of the leak sites.
Works for one client at a time and never says who. Has been near the top for years.
Old hand, older habits. Moves whole herds of data and sells it by the head.
Talks constantly on the boards. Some of it is even true.

taunts: Saw you on the ladder, {handle}. Enjoy the view from down there.
{handle}. You are going to have to move faster than that.
Took that job you were looking at. Hope you don't mind.
overtaken: Fine. Enjoy it while it lasts, {handle}.
So you passed me. I've been passed before.
Well done. Now everyone knows your handle, {handle}. Including the people you don't want to.
tips: {handle}, a peace offering, as agreed. Someone left the door open at {server}. The address is in your book now.
A tip from your new friend. {server} is a quiet place to pass through. Added to your book.
{handle}: {server}. Don't ask how I know. It's in your book.

sniped.headline: Hacker '{rival}' claims break-in at {company}
sniped.body:
{CITY}. A handle known on underground boards as '{rival}' has claimed responsibility for a break-in at {company} this week, posting a screenshot of the company's file list as proof.

The company said it was 'aware of the claim'.

sniped.headline: {company} hit; online boast points to '{rival}'
sniped.body: {CITY}. {company} confirmed an intrusion after a post signed '{rival}' described its network in some detail. Police said they were 'following several lines of inquiry'.
